title: Deciding to be a musician and his family's attitude
summary: He always wanted to be a musician; family neither encouraged nor opposed it, though they might have preferred a lawyer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's funny. Do you remember at what age you decided that you wanted to be a musician?
Well, I think I always wanted to be. It was --

Yeah, back to the hatbox days. And while I wasn't encouraged about it, I wasn't stomped on about it. I mean, nobody said, "Don't you dare touch that horn again," or anything like that. And then I didn't, like, go against the complete wishes of my family, as some people would
I have read somewhere that your family wanted you to be an attorney. Is that right?

Well, they probably would have liked that, but I know my mother -- I asked her one time, I said, "Now, I see you, you're here opening nights and you're around and everything like that. Now, if I'd have been a lawyer, you couldn't have done that." No, I think she was very happy with it, the way it turned out, after all.
